method: Exact rational Walsh reconstruction and affine parameter elimination for the B19 mask-10049 activation witness.
bounded_objective: Replace the single (c,eta) cone failure by its full exact parameter region and state the resulting necessary lower bound for universal SMR.
prior_status: One exact failure at c=7/4, eta=1/4 was proved by B19; no all-parameter region was known.
mathematical_delta: Derived c_q(eta)=23/16+eta and c_F(eta)=1.505684707963186...+1.336806053967517...eta. Proved by exact integer products that c_F-c_q is positive for every eta>=0. Hence zero-cone transfer fails on a nonempty interval for every GU-relevant eta, and universal SMR requires c>=c_F(eta).

verification.arithmetic_scope: Exact rational Walsh masses, rational prime exponents, and direct integer-product sign comparisons; the all-eta extension follows from the affine formula.

remaining_obstacle: No upper bound proves SMR at c>=c_F(eta); the finite witness neither supplies an admissible GU pair nor disproves GU/FEI.
next_action: Tensor or rare-suspend the exact activated witness while retaining terminal reserves; determine whether its necessary c lower bound amplifies or stays finite.
